name: opencode-llm-review-gate
description: llm-review-gate.ts opencode plugin (gates bash tool calls behind an LLM safety review before they run), packed and installed locally by extracting this tarball straight into opencode's own package cache under a bare name@version (no registry, no server - see CLAUDE.md). Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type. Independently installable from hook-logger.ts - not bundled together. After editing llm-review-gate.ts, run `npm pack` in this directory to regenerate the committed opencode-llm-review-gate-1.0.0.tgz - tests/unit/plugins-tarball.test.mjs fails if it drifts from source.
